title: Extract a shared rare-cancer core with rare-cancer-registry-templates
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. Backlog (unscheduled): extract a shared rare-cancer core in coordination with the upstream rare-cancer-registry-templates project. Depends on the PLAN section 16 Q8 decision and requires upstream coordination. Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Specify a shared rare-cancer core extracted from the Ewing standard, coordinated with rare-cancer-registry-templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared rare-cancer core elements identified and separated from Ewing-specific elements
Depends on and references the PLAN section 16 Q8 decision
Each shared element traced to an existing standard or justified as net-new
